pos.personaBrief: Tite's Corinthians and Brazil sat compact and sprang on the counter, but the 2015 side also stressed possession and triangular circulation; a balanced, pragmatic approach.

pro.personaBrief: Fast triangular circulation and a safe holder (Casemiro, Ralf) with patient build-up, though counters were well drilled.

est.personaBrief: Rigid 4-1-4-1 with defined roles, rehearsed phases and tight triangles; wingers and false 10 were allowed to come inside.

lar.personaBrief: Mixed: Willian held width and Neymar stayed wide against deep blocks, but full-backs tucked inside and Jadson cut in.

blo.personaBrief: Compact lines in 4-1-4-1 with mid block, pressing tailored to the opponent and post-loss pressure; Brazil moved the line higher.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal marking is the basis of everything, including set pieces, per Cleber Xavier at the 2018 World Cup.

pla.personaBrief: A consistent method but adaptive: changed to a rigid back four away in Germany and dropped the double pivot against deep blocks.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic, result-first coach whose Corinthians scored little but won; closed games and valued collective discipline.

sis.personaBrief: The collective empowers the individual; stars follow the same duties and the system carries ordinary players.

jog.personaBrief: Valued technical, intelligent midfielders (Renato Augusto, Jadson) with discipline over raw power.

bas.personaBrief: Mixed squad building: trusted veterans and Paulinho/Thiago Silva, while also developing youngsters like Rodriguinho and Malcom.

lid.personaBrief: Warm relationship with players, rotating the captaincy and building a team-first atmosphere, yet everyone follows the same rules.
